messages:
sophie: Quick thread to lock the joint perf/W protocol for the marketplace entry. Partner wants a single recommended SKU + one fallback. Need clear rules for power sampling and steady-state.

rahul: Proposal: external PDU preferred, fall back to IPMI if partner can't provide. Sample at 250ms. Warmup = first 60s, steady-state = next 90s window. Normalize numbers to seq=256 for the marketplace table.

ben: Agreed. We'll also capture a long-context check at seq=1024 (single run) to show tail behavior. Batches: 1,8,32,128. Quant modes to report: fp16, q4_0.

sophie: Acceptance gate idea: best-config tokens/sec/W >= 88% of our certified baseline => "Recommended". 75-88% => "Supported (reduced perf)". <75% => don't list. Keep wording strict in copy.

rahul: Also require smoke eval: 100 prompts, compare logits & top-1 token. Any mismatch = fail listing. We'll add a checksum field in telemetry linking to the eval artifact.

ben: I'll own kernel-tuning checklist. I'll propose up to 3 low-risk patches (thread tuning, kv prefetch, async-copy) with microbench harness and perf/regression thresholds.

rahul: I'll own telemetry schema + parser. Fields: power_source, power_resolution_ms, pdu_csv_uri (optional), ipmi_uri (optional), tokens_per_sec, tokens_per_sec_per_watt, kv_hit_rate, batch_counts. Add field run_artifact_uri for raw tel file.

ben: Example harness command for partner runs:
```
# partner harness example
./rw-bench --model redwood-7b --seq 256 --batch 32 --quant q4_0 \ 
  --telemetry /tmp/tel.json --pdu-csv /tmp/pdu.csv --sample-ms 250
```

partner-ci: partner lab run queued: rp-5223456. Slot booked 2026-04-05 09:00 UTC. Will upload pdu.csv and tel.json to partner S3 when done.

ops-bot: Scheduled run rp-5223456 started. Logs: https://ci.redwood/runtime/rp-5223456

partner-ci: Run finished. Quick numbers: seq256 batch32 q4_0 -> 395 toks/s, steady watts 190W => 2.08 toks/s/W. p50 15ms, p90 30ms. tel: s3://partners-artifacts/5223456/tel.json pdu: s3://partners-artifacts/5223456/pdu.csv

sophie: Thanks. Ben/Rahul please open PRs: telemetry schema + example parser, and kernel patch matrix + microbench results. Tag the run id in PRs. Deadline: Tue EOD so I can draft marketplace blurb Wed. :thumbsup:

ben: PR incoming for patch matrix. Will include expected delta table and risk levels.

rahul: Telemetry schema PR opened: https://git.redwood/partners/telemetry/pulls/30. Parser sample included.

ben: Patch matrix PR opened: https://git.redwood/partners/kernel/pulls/9. Microbench artifacts uploaded to s3.

sophie: Great. One more rule: if partner only provides IPMI (1s resolution) we annotate listing as "measured via IPMI" and still compute tokens/sec/W but mark power_resolution_ms.

partner-ci: Noted; IPMI fallback used for rp-5223456 and marked in tel.json (power_source=ipmi, power_resolution_ms=1000).

rahul: I'll add an automated check in perf pipeline to compute delta vs baseline and post a pass/fail to the PR when artifacts are uploaded.

ops-bot: Perf pipeline computed delta: rp-5223456 is 5% below baseline toks/sec/W => PASS for "Recommended" gate (threshold 12% allowed). Details: https://ci.redwood/perf/rp-5223456/summary

sophie: Awesome. I'll draft the marketplace blurb linking to the raw tel artifacts and the one-line recommended SKU. Review meeting Thurs 11am PT. :rocket:
